verdicts.reason: A and B are pixel-for-pixel almost the same as the original. Both keep the headline / stained-glass window / details banner layout with brand colours and font intact. They share the same minor flaws: 'Sunday' sits only a few pixels from the window's left edge, the grey date and address text is small and low-contrast, and the band of white space below the content is unbalanced. I see no difference between them that matters.
